sam (People Ops): Quick company note: updated travel safety checklist and a small PTO exception process change. Pls read.
iris (Benefits): Travel safety: new mandatory pre-approval required for trips to Level 3 advisory countries. Use Travel Quick Approvals on the portal. Non-compliant bookings will not be reimbursed.
dan (eng): Does the pre-approval affect personal travel where I charge to company card?
iris (Benefits): If using company funds or booking on behalf of Redwood, yes. Personal trips where you later expense a work-related portion still need approval for the work portion.
travel-bot: Travel checklist & approvals: https://intranet.redwood/travel-checklist. Emergency contact & evacuation insurance details updated.
sam (People Ops): PTO exceptions: small change to approvals for overlapping PTO during product freezes. Managers can submit an exception request form; People Ops will respond within 72 hours. Link: https://forms.redwood/pto-exception.
dan (eng): Thanks. Any retro fixes for recent accrual mismatches?
isis (typo)  
(assistant) iris (Benefits): We're finishing reconciliation; affected folks will get a retro top-up in the next payroll. We'll message individuals directly.
sam (People Ops): Thanks everyone  ping @sam or @iris for urgent issues.
